start.text: Veyron hasn't changed as much as I expected. That's probably the problem.

take-cab.text: North Hills? That's a long ride this late.

inspect-house.text: Marcus wouldn't leave this lying around. He wanted someone to find it.

complete.text: First night back, and already somebody left me a trail.

start.text: If Marcus was moving money, there should be a record somewhere.

account.text: The account is older than most of the staff here. What exactly are you looking for?

complete.text: There it is. Someone wanted this buried.

start.text: You really came back to Veyron and thought nobody would notice?
I was hoping for one quiet day.

action.text: One name. That's not enough. Keep digging.

complete.text: Three names. Three connections. That's too deliberate.

start.text: Unknown number. Nobody calls by accident anymore.

action.text: If you're hearing my voice, you're already closer than you should be.
Someone who knows what happens next if you keep asking the wrong questions.

complete.text: Now you know where to look. Don't make me regret telling you.

start.text: Central first. Bank, market, headquarters, then the safehouse. We keep the route clean.

market-log.text: Market is busy. Which means we're less interesting.

police-log.text: Police headquarters. Try not to become memorable.

safehouse-log.text: Route complete. We know where the pressure is.

complete.text: Okay. Now we're actually in this.

start.text: Quiet streets. Expensive houses. Money moves differently up here.

complete.text: Nobody saw us. That's the point.

start.text: Malik's workshop is exactly where I'd expect him to hide.

action.text: You disappear for years, walk back in, and now you need my help?
I need someone I can trust.

complete.text: Fine. We're in it together. But if this goes bad, I'm blaming you first.

start.text: Port never sleeps. Cameras do, sometimes. People don't.

container.text: This is the container. Open it carefully.
You say that like you've done this before.

escape.text: Leave. Now. Your window just closed.

complete.text: We got the evidence. Nobody needs to know how.

start.text: Police headquarters. Everybody remembers something. The trick is finding out what.

action.text: I remember Marcus. I also remember what happened to people who asked about him.
Then tell me what you know before somebody else decides for you.

complete.text: Three conversations. Three different stories. Somebody's lying.

start.text: Rule one: never trust a clean story. Clean stories are usually prepared.

action.text: That's the first piece. Keep going.

complete.text: Now you can see the pattern. The question is whether you're ready for what it means.
I didn't come back to Veyron for easy answers.
